aggregation.method: Arithmetic mean of L2-normalized window embeddings, followed by L2 normalization.

license.attribution: LAION CLAP; Yusong Wu, Ke Chen, Tianyu Zhang, Yuchen Hui, Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick, Shlomo Dubnov.

preprocessing.amplitudePolicy: Decode float32; mean channels in float64 then float32; soxr HQ resample to 48000 Hz; no loudness or peak normalization; zero-pad windows; processor padding=pad and truncation=rand_trunc on exactly 480000 samples (no crop).

windowing.selectionPolicy: Starts at 0, 10, and 20 seconds when start < decoded duration; analyzes at most first 30 seconds; no random crop.
windowing.shortAudioPolicy: Right zero-pad each partial 10-second window to 480000 samples; coverage excludes padding.
